headline: Air pollution costs India up to 9.5% of GDP, new report says
dek: A new report links air pollution in India to 2 million deaths and calls for health-led action, NDTV reported.
body:
Air pollution costs India up to 9.5% of its gross domestic product (GDP), according to a new report covered by NDTV.

The report also links 2 million deaths to air pollution, NDTV's headline said. The report calls for health-led action in response.

The NDTV item available to LungDaily gave only its headline. It did not say who produced the report, what period the figures cover, how the economic cost was calculated, or what specific measures the report recommends. Those details are therefore not reported here.

LungDaily will update this article if further details of the report become available.
key_quote: Air Pollution Costs India Up To 9.5% Of GDP

source.title: Air Pollution Costs India Up To 9.5% Of GDP, 2 Million Deaths Linked: New Report Calls For Health-Led Action - NDTV
